The '''''Death Rattle''''' was the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Tor Vizsla]], leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]. It was destroyed in orbit over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] when [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] slammed a ship in the engines, therefore decapitating the ''Death Rattle'', where it plunged to its "death" on the planet below.
